take: The bye is close to locked (97.4%), so your season is really two games: Week 16 and Week 17. Every move below is judged mostly on those two lineups, with Weeks 12 to 14 still counted so nobody who stinks until then sneaks in.
You win it all in 22.7% of sims. Your biggest threat is Chasing Brown Huzz at 26.5%. That's down from 24.1% last update.
Best trade they should actually accept: D'Andre Swift for Mike Evans with Chasing Brown Huzz. Title odds +2.3 and their lineup moves -0.1 a week.
Backup plan: KC Concepcion for Carnell Tate (Griffin's Great Team), +1.3.
Swing big if they bite: D'Andre Swift for Jonah Coleman + Jameson Williams (BO liever) is worth +5.7, but it hurts their lineup so expect a no unless they're desperate.
Biggest risk: C.J. Stroud getting hurt costs you 17.7 points of title odds. Make sure you have a real backup there.
Waivers: Dameon Pierce (RB) for Kaleb Johnson adds about 3.9 weighted lineup points.
